title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions on this week's biggest stories, from a Tokyo judo mat to an MLS pitch under fire.

questions.question: In the final of the 2019 World Judo Championships in Tokyo, who did Sagi Muki beat by ippon to become Israel's first male world judo champion?
questions.explanation: Muki defeated Belgium's Matthias Casse by ippon with 1:21 remaining in the -81kg final at the Nippon Budokan.

questions.question: Before his contentious move to Besiktas, which Israeli club did American point guard David DeJulius play for in the 2024-25 EuroLeague season?
questions.explanation: DeJulius played for Maccabi Tel Aviv in EuroLeague during 2024-25 before joining UCAM Murcia in summer 2025.

questions.question: Which Israeli forward scored for New England Revolution against CF Montréal while being targeted with antisemitic chants from the crowd?
questions.explanation: Dor Turgeman scored New England's second goal in the 36th minute and was abused by Montreal fans chanting 'Death to Israel.'

questions.question: Hapoel Beer Sheva face which club, featuring veteran Marko Arnautović, in the Champions League third qualifying round?
questions.explanation: Israel's reigning champions Hapoel Beer Sheva meet Red Star Belgrade, whom Arnautović joined as a free agent after leaving Inter Milan.

questions.question: How did Beitar Jerusalem see off AEK Larnaca in the Conference League after the tie finished 3-3 on aggregate?
questions.explanation: Goalkeeper Miguel Silva saved two spot-kicks as Beitar won the shootout 4-3 to advance to face Austria Wien.
